content: I'm afraid I can't agree with that. An argument is only considered airtight after it has been presented, analyzed, and found to be logically sound and well-supported. Until you have shown your argument and provided the necessary evidence and reasoning, it's impossible to evaluate whether it is airtight or not. If you'd like to share your argument, I'd be happy to help you assess its strength and validity!
